given: a stock record already exists for a (SKU, location) pair
when: a warehouse operator files a stock record for that same SKU-at-location pair again with a different quantity
then: the existing record is updated in place, exactly one record exists for that pair, no duplicate record is created, and no error page is shown

independence.rationale: This asserts the write-collision path (same pair filed twice resolves to an in-place update with no duplicate), which is independently breakable from AC1's first-write create: an implementation can create the first record correctly yet insert a duplicate or error on the second filing.
